## Description
A friendly, beginner-accessible issue designed to welcome new contributors.

## Task Goal
Explain what needs to be changed in 2-3 sentences.

## Why It Matters
Explain the benefit to the project and community.

## Suggested Files
- `path/to/file1.py`
- `path/to/file2.tsx`

## Step-by-Step Instructions
1. Fork the repo and set up the local environment (`./scripts/setup-dev-env.sh`).
2. Locate the suggested file above.
3. Make the requested change.
4. Run tests: `pytest` (backend) or `npm run typecheck && npm run lint` (frontend).
5. Open a Pull Request referencing this issue.

## Definition of Done
- [ ] Code changes implemented.
- [ ] Linting & tests pass cleanly.
- [ ] PR submitted with Conventional Commit title.
